items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: You remember Roger Wolfe, huh? Yeah. When they give me that record.

ctx.x: Yeah, he come here every time they came here. Every time George would come in town, he came with them, you know, and all. And that's when they give Popper the record. You remember that, Johnny.
You remember Roger Wolfe, huh? Yeah. When they give me that record. Yeah. You couldn't give me a thousand dollars for that thing. Oh, did not.
